nom: medicube Zero Pore Blackhead Mud Mask

segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, mild hormonal acne-prone skin found the mask burned on a second use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report mixed results: one found it effective and non-stripping despite a strong scent, another calls it the best clay mask ever with no burning, while a third with dry, mild-acne skin experienced burning.

concerns.spots: Reviewers dealing with blackheads on the nose, chin and brows report noticeable reduction after one to three uses, with pores appearing smaller and skin smoother; one reviewer with mild acne and blackheads saw barely any difference after four months of weekly use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with mild hormonal acne experienced burning on a second use; another with sensitive skin and cycle-related breakouts found it effective without irritation.

aspects.libelle: Fails to improve texture or blackheads
Leaves skin feeling clean, not stripped

extraits.texte: I bought this like 4 months ago, and I've used in once per week since. Every time, there is barely a difference in my blackheads and my skin texture/mild acne. My pores look the same too. It wont hurt you to use this, but it is definitely a waste of money because it does close to nothing! I leave it on for 7 minutes which is already longer then recommended and the results are still the same.
First use was great, second use 2 weeks later…burned the heck out of my face. I have dry skin with mild acne (mostly hormonal)

I have sensitive skin, and I typically break out with my cycle. My acne usually requires minimum intervention (like I usually just wash my face and use a pimple patch) but I do get blackheads pretty frequently on my chin and nose. I use this about once a week, and I love it! It's effective and makes my skin feel clean and clear without stripping. Only thing I dislike is the scent, it's almost eucalyptus-y and is a little strong for my preference.

I've always disliked clay masks for 2 reasons: 1) made a mess 2) burned my sensitive skin I was intrigued to buy this mask because I love how medicube products feel on my skin, and the color of course is gorgeous. I love using the active ingredients of AHA/BHA as a serum to tighten my pores, but using it as a mask was an 11/10 experience! No flaking with cracks and washes off smoothly. No burning sensation or irritation! I could feel it tightening my pores as it dried, and it left my face looking glassy and not dry. This review is probably overkill but I am in love with this product!

Ive had stubborn balckheads on my nose, chin, and in between my eyebrows forever. After 1 use of this mask there is a very noticeable difference in appearance and texture. After 3 uses my skin is brighter, clearer, and overall smoother. I absolutely love all medicare products! 100% recommend!!!

This mask is a must! I use it once a week and it keeps my sebaceous filaments clear and my pores small. I wash my face, apply this mask for 3 minutes, wash off and then use my oil cleanser to wash one more time. I feel like the oil cleanser really plays an important roll here.

reserve: Only six reviews are available, so conclusions per skin type and concern rest on very small numbers of accounts.
